title: [BUG] Screen "glitches" until I hit up or down arrow in recent updates when it is asking for approval
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ x] Anthropic API
- Claude CLI version: 0.2.64 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: Windows 11, WSL - Ubuntu

## Bug Description
Screen "glitches" until I hit up or down arrow in recent updates when it is asking for approval

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Give commands until some scroll length is established.
2. Do not set to auto accept
3. The screen will glitch and not display the section it should until up or down arrow is pressed.


## Expected Behavior
It to display the file it is editing with its contents and the options.

## Actual Behavior
The scroll text seems to break.

## Additional Context
Before an up/down arrow is hit:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b2f70145-9faa-4bc6-b65a-c2c560d2332d)

After an up/down arrow is hit:
